en: a quantity of work that should have been done already, but has not yet been done
ex: When she eventually returned to work, there was a tremendous backlog of paperwork to catch up on.
当她最终重返工作岗位时，积压了大量的文书工作。

en: an outdoor area in a film studio, where pieces of scenery are made and some scenes are filmed
the person, horse, etc. who is in last position in a race
furthest back
ex: the backmost teeth
最里面的牙齿

zh: （尤指登山者或远足者使用的）背包，旅行包
en: a bag that you carry on your back, made of strong material and often used by people who go climbing or walking
ex: She swung her backpack over her shoulder.
她把背包甩到背上。

en: a person who goes backpacking

zh: 底板，背板（可接其他装置的电路板）
en: a circuit board that other devices can be connected to
part of a seat that supports somebody’s back

zh: 互开方便之门，互相利用（常指从事非法活动）
en: the fact of giving somebody help in return for help that they have given you, often in connection with something that might be illegal

zh: （一些亚洲国家中的）施舍，小费，小额贿赂
en: (in some Asian countries) a small amount of money that is given as a gift to poor people, or given to somebody to thank them or to persuade them to help you

zh: （转成间接引语时的）时态后移
en: the changing of a tense when reporting what somebody said, for example when reporting the words ‘What are you doing?’ as ‘He asked me what I was doing.’
the part of the body that you sit on
ex: Get up off your backside and do some work!
起来干点活儿吧！

en: loud and enthusiastic behaviour when people are praising each other for something good they have done
a mark ( \), used in computer commands
